correctness.rationale: The final claim concerns all k>=3 five-edge-arm trees and Ind_2 faces of induced components<=2. Independently checked Q4→Q3 by three elementary collapses and Q5→point by eleven, using actual forbidden triples. Deleting the center gives D=Q5^{*k} contractible. The center link equals A=Q4^{*k} with k cones on B_i=Q3*Q4^{*(k−1)} attached through homotopy equivalences B_i→A; the first cone contracts A and k−1 additional cones give L≃∨^{k−1}S^{2k}, hence K≃ΣL≃∨^{k−1}S^{2k+1}. The exact integral LES for (L,A) identifies H_{2k}(L;Z) as ker(Z^k→Z); join-factor swaps of degree-one homology incur sign (+1), proving the untwisted integral S_k augmentation lattice and vanishing of other reduced groups. Independent full-face mod-2 Betti and every signed Lefschetz trace checked for k=2,3; k=4 421853-face enumeration gives reduced Euler −3. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the unbounded link/LES proof.

value.rationale: A canonical class of genuinely branching trees has an explicit infinite-family homotopy classification refining general vertex-decomposability/shellability. The top Betti number k−1 grows with branch count, and the complete integral S_k action distinguishes invariant and noninvariant homology information invisible to ordinary Betti numbers. A structural center-link attachment calculation is reusable and mathematically motivated; it is neither a finite tabulation nor a mere relabeling of a path or the unrelated Morse complex.
